Introducing Shopsy
Returns honge kam
Do you want to reduce your courier returns? Introducing Shopsy’s Prepaid program - Returns honge kam. Opt into this program to reduce courier returns by giving a discount of Rs.10 only to customers for choosing prepaid orders. According to our research, customers who choose prepaid orders are less likely to return their products up to 70%. Additionally, low returns have benefits like - Saving on packaging & labeling expenses, Reduction in Manpower & operation costs along with a Smooth Inventory Management system.
Prepaid Offer opt-ins:
1. nb:mp:103506ef23 (UPI Payments)
2. nb:mp:10ead4d722 (Net banking/Debit/Credit Cards)
3. Select only Shopsy exclusive listings SKU ID.
We suggest Opt-into both offers as your customer may choose either mode for payment. Steps to opt-in: Log in to your Seller dashboard > Growth tab > Flipkart promotions > Paste the above offer ids in the search box and opt-in.

Videos QC Guidelines

  1. Product details shown in the video must match the listing images and attributes.
  2. Video should be high quality with the product clearly visible.
  3. Audio should be only in English or Hindi.
  4. Recommended video aspect ratio is 3:4 or 9:16 for full visibility on the Flipkart customer platform.
  5. Video should not contain excessive background noise.
  6. Do not use movie audio or copyrighted music.
  7. Do not include social media handles, tags, or influencer promotions.
  8. Do not include competitor or other website names, logos, QR codes, or promotional mentions.
  9. Video should not contain watermarks or copyright text.
  10. Do not mention prices, offers, or discounts in the video.
